extras: 100% Local & Offline. Zero Telemetry. All flashcards live directly in your Markdown notes.
motivation: I created this suite of Obsidian plugins and the DoomEsque theme so that I can be 100 percent certain there are no network calls or traffic: everything runs 100 percent offline, so I can use Obsidian for my notes in open-book law exams.
problem: Users need a focused, offline study environment that combines spaced repetition scheduling with timed focus sessions.
summary: Spaced repetition flashcards that utilize the SM-2 algorithm and feature an integrated Pomodoro focus timer.
